game.name: Wii Party
game.rules:
**EVIDENCE RULES**

- All runs require video proof with in-game audio as of June 23, 2024.
- The entire screen must be clearly visible and must record through the entire duration of the run.
- Your video/picture must stay available to view for at least 30 days after verification. After this, it may be grandfathered in when there are rule changes, but may be rejected if the rule changes require having to change the run's time.

**PLATFORM RULES**

- Modifying Wii Party in any way is not allowed.
- If you run Wii Party without an official disc copy in a Wii/vWii, then it is unofficial and must be marked as an emulator. It is allowed but hidden by default. We may put in a time in the description with disc copy-like loading times applied depending on what position you get, but the run will still be hidden.
- If your run shows signs of using an unofficial copy (usually from faster loading times), but deny using one, you will be asked to show video evidence of using an official copy.

**TIMING RULES**

- Milliseconds are not used unless it is stated otherwise in the rules or to break a tie where we deem important.

categories.name: [WSO Archive] All Categories (Shortened)
categories.rules:
- This is a temporary category for the Wii Series Olympics. This is a spinoff of All Categories that sees the runner only doing one game in each game category.
- In any order, do the following:

Finish a Party game (Bingo suggested)

Finish a Pair game (Balance Boat Time Attack Beginner suggested, Balance Boat must be won)

Finish a House Party game (Time Bomb suggested)

Finish a category of minigames in Free Play (All 1v3 Minigames suggested)

Finish a game in Battle mode (4 Player/1 vs 1 Play to 3 suggested)

Win a game in Solo mode (Beginner suggested)

Finish a Challenge game (Shifty Gifts suggested, you may intentionally fail Shifty Gifts)

Finish Spot the Sneak/Rule Reversal (3 Rounds suggested)

- Time starts when you start/restart your first category and ends depending on the category:

"Victory" for Bingo, Battle, Solo Beginner, and Spot the Sneak/Rule Reversal

"Finish" for Free Play minigames and Shifty Gifts

"Balanced" for Balance Boat

The end results screen for Time Bomb

- 2 controllers are required for some categories, and it is optional for the rest, but no more than 2 controllers may be used.
- Fast exits are not allowed.

values.name: All
values.rules:
**All Minigames Rules**

- Play through all 4 Player, 1v1, 1v3, and Pair minigames in any order.
- Any player/CPU/controller can win the minigames for "Finish". For "Win", Player 1 must win for 1P, and one player/controller has to win all of the minigames for multiple players and multiple controllers.
- You may swap teams in the 1v3 minigames, but your team has to win for the "Win" condition.
- You may swap the amount of players/controllers anytime for multiple players/controllers runs. Make sure to submit all the players that contributed to the run, with a maximum of four.

- RTA timing is used.
- For "Finish" you may only fast exit when "Finish", "Time's Up" or "Game Over" appears. For "Win", there are exceptions listed below.

**Fast Exits for "Win"**

- In Smile Snap, exit when all the faces have been counted.
- In Saucer Snap, exit when the screen zooms in to your picture (you will have to wait until the results screen if it doesn't zoom).
- In Shutterpup, exit when all of the pictures have been displayed.
- In Stop Watchers, exit after the times are revealed.
- In Walk-Off, exit when the Mii celebrates.
- In Flying Fruit, exit when all the fruit has been counted.
- In Commuter Count, exit when the passengers change facial expression after the final count.
- In Fishin' Buddies, exit when you have 5 points.
- In Robot Factory, exit when you have 7 points.
- In Flycycle Team, exit when you reach 300 ft or 300 m.
- In Spring Ringers, exit when you have 10 points                      
- In Jump Rope Jam, exit when you have 15 points.
- In Can Poppers, exit when you have 30 points when "Finish" appears.
- In Sheep Crossing, exit when you have 10 points.
- In Pop Coaster, exit when you have 30 points.
- In Basket Bonanza, exit when you have 30 points.
- In Bumper Crops, exit when you have 30 points.

games.name: Wii Party
games.rules:
**EVIDENCE RULES**

- All runs require video proof with in-game audio as of June 23, 2024.
- The entire screen must be clearly visible and must record through the entire duration of the run.
- Your video/picture must stay available to view for at least 30 days after verification. After this, it may be grandfathered in when there are rule changes, but may be rejected if the rule changes require having to change the run's time.

**PLATFORM RULES**

- Modifying Wii Party in any way is not allowed.
- If you run Wii Party without an official disc copy in a Wii/vWii, then it is unofficial and must be marked as an emulator. It is allowed but hidden by default. We may put in a time in the description with disc copy-like loading times applied depending on what position you get, but the run will still be hidden.
- If your run shows signs of using an unofficial copy (usually from faster loading times), but deny using one, you will be asked to show video evidence of using an official copy.

**TIMING RULES**

- Milliseconds are not used unless it is stated otherwise in the rules or to break a tie where we deem important.

values.name: All
values.rules:
**All Minigames Rules**

- Play through all 4 Player, 1v1, 1v3, and Pair minigames in any order.
- Any player/CPU/controller can win the minigames for "Finish". For "Win", Player 1 must win for 1P, and one player/controller has to win all of the minigames for multiple players and multiple controllers.
- You may swap teams in the 1v3 minigames, but your team has to win for the "Win" condition.
- You may swap the amount of players/controllers anytime for multiple players/controllers runs. Make sure to submit all the players that contributed to the run, with a maximum of four.

- RTA timing is used.
- For "Finish" you may only fast exit when "Finish", "Time's Up" or "Game Over" appears. For "Win", there are exceptions listed below.

**Fast Exits for "Win"**

- In Smile Snap, exit when all the faces have been counted.
- In Saucer Snap, exit when the screen zooms in to your picture (you will have to wait until the results screen if it doesn't zoom).
- In Shutterpup, exit when all of the pictures have been displayed.
- In Stop Watchers, exit after the times are revealed.
- In Walk-Off, exit when the Mii celebrates.
- In Flying Fruit, exit when all the fruit has been counted.
- In Commuter Count, exit when the passengers change facial expression after the final count.
- In Fishin' Buddies, exit when you have 5 points.
- In Robot Factory, exit when you have 7 points.
- In Flycycle Team, exit when you reach 300 ft or 300 m.
- In Spring Ringers, exit when you have 10 points                      
- In Jump Rope Jam, exit when you have 15 points.
- In Can Poppers, exit when you have 30 points when "Finish" appears.
- In Sheep Crossing, exit when you have 10 points.
- In Pop Coaster, exit when you have 30 points.
- In Basket Bonanza, exit when you have 30 points.
- In Bumper Crops, exit when you have 30 points.
